## delightful-zoo

### Description and Rationale
We are a team of operational Air Traffic Controllers and Meteorological Specialists based in Senegal, combining hands-on aviation expertise with backgrounds in technology, data science, and AI. While technology rapidly advances across global industries, modernizing aviation workflows remains a critical challenge—a gap our team is uniquely positioned to help bridge. 
A primary driver for our participation in the PRC Challenge is pushing sustainable aviation forward. Environmental efficiency is central to our vision for future airport operations; by leveraging data to accurately estimate and reduce CO2 emissions, we align directly with the sustainability goals of our ANSPs. We are participating in this challenge to apply data-driven intelligence to real-world operational and environmental efficiency

### Details

* Number of team members: 3
* Type: Industry, Independent
* Affiliation: ASECNA
* Country: Senegal
